summary: Finalize v1.4.1 log workflow as Evidence -> Draft -> Write: change-window snapshots preserve evidence, log draft creates reviewable cache/report artifacts, and log write performs explicitly authorized source-of-truth Diary writes. This closes the accept-after-log gap while keeping AI agents from automatically writing decision memory.
